lesson.title: Ups and downs
lesson.subtitle: P4 line-graph revision
lesson.objective: Find differences and the biggest change between points.
lesson.story: A line graph shows visitors for Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri.

steps.title: Read a point
steps.prompt: How many visitors does the graph show for Mon?
hints: Find Mon along the bottom and go up to its point.
Read across to the scale and use the size of each step.
The point is 4 whole steps and a half step up.

steps.title: Find the difference
steps.prompt: How many more visitors are shown for Tue than for Mon?
hints: Read both points from the scale first.
To find how many more, take the smaller number from the larger.

steps.title: Find the biggest climb
steps.prompt: Between which two neighbouring points did the line climb the most?
hints: A climb is where the line goes up from one point to the next.
Work out how far the line goes up between each pair of neighbours.
Between Thu to Fri the line climbs 15.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: How can you tell where a line graph climbs the most?

choices.label: Find the part of the line that climbs the most between two neighbours.
Find the highest point on the whole graph, because the biggest climb ends there.
Compare the first and last points, since the climb is between them.

hints: Think about how the line moves between points.
A big climb means a big change from one point to the next.
The highest point can come after a small climb.
Choose the explanation about the furthest climb between neighbours.
